policy: Metadata is reviewed; references are generated with scripts/repo/check_source_conformance.py --update-rv64-flag-references. Regeneration cannot declare flags or change defaults. Default expressions describe the variable being absent, not preset overrides. Runtime, qualification, frozen and retire-after-native-default count toward the live target; constants and reference-only names do not. The strict promotion check requires <60 live names and no M7/M8 switch. Every live flag requires an ISO expires date; expiry rejects ordinary CI and reference refresh cannot renew it. Constants and reference-only names are not environment switches.

default_evidence.text:
ALLOW_BLOCKS_ENV = "STWO_RV64_HARNESS_ALLOW_BLOCKS"


def allowed_blocks(args, environ=None):
    """Explicit owner opt-in for non-development blocks: --allow-block N (repeatable) or
    STWO_RV64_HARNESS_ALLOW_BLOCKS=N[,M]. Harness-only: STWO_RV64_* keys never reach the producer."""
    environ = os.environ if environ is None else environ
    result = set(getattr(args, "allow_block", None) or [])
    for item in environ.get(ALLOW_BLOCKS_ENV, "").replace(",", " ").split():
        result.add(int(item))
